dropped.why: no published bound with a stated frequency inside the window found. Komori 2020 torsion pendulum gives ~1.9e-04 (DERIVED, Eq. 4) at its best torque (~50-150 Hz region, frequency not stated) - weaker than LIGO there. Fuchs 2024 levitated 26.7 Hz (outside). Altamura 2024 (Eot-Wash rotational) samples mHz. LPF 2018 ASD: published range above 30 mHz not stated in text -> not extended.
mechanical thermal population not given in text; sub-micron mode geometry ~ r_C needs the full mode shape.

dropped.item: Quartz BAW (MHz) / Si optomechanical crystals (5 GHz)
dropped.why: no occupation/heating numbers with geometry fetched; shear modes (k.u = 0) couple weakly; not attempted this stage.

flags: HBAR 5.0486 GHz: 1.55e-06 at r_C=100 nm vs paper 5.7e-08 at its own convention (optimum hbar/sigma_q, not r_C = 100 nm) - same factor as Stage 33 Schrinski.
Membrane bounds attribute all measured thermal heating to the effect (upper limits only, no excess search).
Seis 2022 bath runs at ~80 mK while the cryostat is at 30 mK (attributed to vibration-isolation limits by the authors) - an excess heating, but not a candidate: bound uses all of it.
